lines.text: Top of the tower. The board is in session. Three directors, and every one of them voted yes on the underclass.
lines.spoken: Top of the tower. The board is in session. Three directors, and every one of them voted yes on the underclass.

lines.text: Order, order. First item on the agenda: the intruder. All in favour of making them go away? Motion carries. It always carries.
lines.spoken: Order, order. First item on the agenda. The intruder. All in favour of making them go away? Motion carries. It always carries.

lines.text: The directors are tougher than anything you've fought so far, and they bring security to every meeting. Use everything you've got.
